doc.headline: No configuration is shown to clear both gates; Brisk-S with high reasoning and a retry clears the pass-rate gate in every task but its overall p95 of {measure.latency_ms.brisk-s.high.r1.p95} misses the {criteria.p95.threshold} budget.
doc.lede: Every one of the 18 configurations fails the pass-rate gate in some task, except the two high-reasoning-plus-retry Brisk-S and Atlas-M arms, which have no per-task latency figure. Per-task p95 latency would settle both.
